title: project
description: Projects trusted by the gui control plane (GET/POST /v1/projects): one project or the list of them, chosen by the const field kind.

project.description: A registered project without the document envelope.

id.description: Project id: slug of the root folder name and the first 8 hex characters of the sha256 of its real path.

name.description: Display name: the base name of the root folder.

root.description: Absolute real path of the project root (symlinks resolved when it was added).

trusted.description: Whether commands may run in the project; a project is added only by an explicit act of the owner, so it is always true in v1.

source.description: How the project was added: open (gui open/serve with --project or the current folder) or user (a confirmed POST /v1/projects).
